name: add_goal
description: Persist a structured goal to state/goals.json without running it (write). Use this only when a durable objective with a completion criterion is needed for a later `run --goal <id>` or the goal board. Not a kanban card and never an executor.
llm_description: Persist a structured goal without running it. Required: "objective", "completion_criterion". Optional: "proof", "boundaries", "stop_rule", "max_iterations" (integer 1..1000), "worktree" (branch/path for worktree runs). Returns its id. Link cards via kanban_* goal id. This is not a board card and must not execute the goal.
